wk.march.name: March
wk.march.purpose: For keeping up on family walks
tips: Stand or sit tall, eyes ahead
Lift one foot, set it down softly
Arms swing, or hands rest on thighs
wk.march.easier: Just lift your heels, toes stay down
wk.march.harder: Knees a little higher, arms press forward

limitNotes.jointReplacement: Keep your knees well below your hips

wk.heel-dig.name: Heel dig
tips: Heel down in front, toes up
Bring the foot back, then switch
Upper body stays tall and still
wk.heel-dig.easier: Slow it down, same small reach

wk.side-step.name: Side step
tips: Step out to the side, then together
Knees soft, toes point forward
Hips stay level, eyes ahead
wk.side-step.easier: Small steps, hands on your hips
wk.side-step.harder: Wider steps, arms open to the sides

limitNotes.dizzy: Small steps, close to your chair

wk.knee-lift.name: Knee lift
tips: Hold the chair or seat lightly
Knee no higher than your hip
Foot points forward, body tall
wk.knee-lift.easier: Lift lower, hand on the chair
wk.knee-lift.harder: Touch the knee with the opposite hand

limitNotes.jointReplacement: Knees stay clearly below your hips

wk.toe-tap.name: Toe tap forward
tips: Tap your toes out in front
Knee stays a little bent
Stay tall, don't lean back
wk.toe-tap.easier: Tap a little closer to you
wk.toe-tap.harder: A low kick, knee never locked

wk.heel-back.name: Heel to back
tips: Hold the chair, stand tall
Bring your heel back and up
Knee points down, don't lean forward
wk.heel-back.easier: Lift your heel only a little
wk.heel-back.harder: Hands off the chair, if you feel steady

limitNotes.jointReplacement: Bend only as far as feels comfortable

wk.shift.name: Weight shift
tips: Feet a little wider than your hips
Shift your weight side to side
Knees stay over your toes
wk.shift.easier: Hold the chair as you shift
wk.shift.harder: Let the other heel lift a little

wk.arms.name: Arm swing / press
tips: Swing your arms, elbows soft
Or press forward at shoulder height
Shoulders stay down and relaxed
wk.arms.easier: Keep your hands below your shoulders
wk.arms.harder: Press up and out at an angle

limitNotes.shoulders: Keep your hands below shoulder height

mv.sit-to-stand.name: Sit-to-stand
tips: Feet flat, hip-width apart
Lean forward, nose over toes
Use your hands on the chair if you need to
mv.sit-to-stand.easier: Push up with your hands on the chair
mv.sit-to-stand.harder: Arms crossed, sit down on a slow count of three

mv.knee-lift.name: Seated knee lift
tips: Hold the sides of your seat
Sit tall, don't lean back
Lift, then set down softly
mv.knee-lift.easier: Just lift your heel, toes stay down
mv.knee-lift.harder: Lift a little higher and swing the opposite arm

mv.leg-ext.name: Seated leg extension
tips: Hold the sides of your seat
Leg points straight ahead
Lower it slowly
mv.leg-ext.harder: Hold it up for a count of three

mv.heel-toe.name: Heel and toe raises
tips: Feet flat to start
Lift heels, then lower
Now lift toes, heels stay down
mv.heel-toe.harder: Stand behind your chair and rise onto your toes

mv.wall-push.name: Wall push-up
mv.wall-push.purpose: For pushing doors and lifting bags
tips: Hands flat at shoulder height
Body straight, like a plank
Heels stay on the floor
mv.wall-push.easier: Stand closer, bend your elbows just a bit
mv.wall-push.harder: Step your feet back a little

mv.single-leg.name: Single-leg stand
tips: Hold the chair with both hands
Look at one spot ahead
Lift your foot just a little
mv.single-leg.easier: Lift only your heel, toes stay down
mv.single-leg.harder: Hold on with just one hand

limitNotes.unsteady: Both hands, lift just your heel

mv.side-leg.name: Side leg raise
mv.side-leg.purpose: For getting out of the car
tips: Hold the chair back with both hands
Lift about a hand's height, toes forward
Stay tall, no leaning to the side
mv.side-leg.easier: A smaller lift, both hands on the chair
mv.side-leg.harder: Hold on with just one hand

limitNotes.jointReplacement: A small lift, toes and knee face forward

mv.back-leg.name: Back leg raise
tips: Stand tall, hands on the chair
Leg moves straight back, toes down
Don't lean forward or arch your back
mv.back-leg.easier: A smaller lift, just off the floor
mv.back-leg.harder: Pause at the top for a moment

limitNotes.lowerBack: A small lift, no arching your back

mv.knee-curl.name: Knee curl
tips: Hands on the chair, stand tall
Bring your heel up behind you
Knee points down, thigh stays still
mv.knee-curl.easier: Bend your knee only a little
mv.knee-curl.harder: Hands off the chair, if you feel steady

limitNotes.jointReplacement: Bend only as far as feels comfortable

mv.mini-squat.name: Mini-squat
tips: Both hands on the chair, feet hip-width
Sit back a little, heels stay down
Knees point forward, not past your toes
mv.mini-squat.easier: Just a small bend at the knees
mv.mini-squat.harder: Lower on a slow count of three

limitNotes.knees: Halfway only, stop if your heels lift

mv.arm-raise.name: Arm raises
tips: Sit tall, feet flat
Raise your arms to shoulder height
Elbows soft, shoulders stay down
mv.arm-raise.easier: Lift only partway, below your shoulders
mv.arm-raise.harder: Pause at the top, or reach overhead

mv.row.name: Seated row
tips: Arms out in front, palms facing in
Pull your elbows back past your ribs
Squeeze your shoulder blades together
mv.row.harder: Hold the squeeze for a count of two

st.neck-turn.name: Neck turn
tips: Chin level, shoulders down
Only as far as is comfortable
st.neck-turn.easier: Turn halfway, eyes open, move slowly

st.neck-tilt.name: Side of the neck
tips: Hand on the opposite shoulder
Ear toward shoulder, no pulling
st.neck-tilt.easier: Tilt a little, skip the hand on the shoulder

st.chin-tuck.name: Chin tuck
st.chin-tuck.purpose: For after reading or screen time
tips: Glide your head straight back
Eyes level, don't look up
st.chin-tuck.easier: A smaller glide, just a few times

st.shoulder-roll.name: Shoulder rolls
st.shoulder-roll.purpose: For shoulders after a busy day
tips: Roll up, back, then down, slowly
Head still, hands on your thighs

st.chest.name: Chest and shoulders
tips: Shoulders back and down
Chest forward and up, gently
st.chest.easier: Hands resting on your hips instead of arms out

st.upper-back.name: Upper back reach
tips: Arms forward, palms facing away
Reach forward, lower back stays tall
st.upper-back.easier: Keep your hands a little lower

limitNotes.lowerBack: Back stays straight, just reach your arms

st.twist.name: Upper back twist
st.twist.purpose: For turning to reach for things
tips: Arms crossed, hands on shoulders
Turn from the chest, hips stay still
st.twist.easier: Turn a small way, head in line with your body

st.side.name: Side stretch
tips: Sit tall, feet flat
Reach up and over, or slide your hand down
st.side.easier: Arm by your side, lean a little

st.thigh.name: Back of the thigh
tips: Heel down, toes up
Lean forward from the hips, back long
st.thigh.easier: Keep the knee soft, lean only slightly

st.ankle.name: Ankle circles and points
tips: Hold the side of the seat
Point your toes away, then back
st.ankle.easier: Keep your heel on the floor, just lift and lower your toes

st.calf.name: Calf stretch
tips: Both feet flat, back heel down
Hold the chair the whole time
st.calf.easier: Shorter step back, back knee a little bent

st.overhead.name: Overhead reach at the wall
tips: Walk your hands up the wall
Heels down, don't arch your back
st.overhead.easier: Stop when your hands reach eye level

limitNotes.standingIsHard: Sit tall and reach up instead

st.back-ext.name: Standing back extension
tips: Hands on your hips
Lean back only a little
Chin level, eyes ahead
st.back-ext.easier: Hold the chair, a smaller lean

bl.tandem.name: Tandem stance
tips: Hold the chair the whole time
Front heel touches your back toes
Knees soft, eyes straight ahead
bl.tandem.easier: Front foot a little to the side
bl.tandem.harder: Just your fingertips on the chair

limitNotes.jointReplacement: Feet stay in line, never crossing over

bl.side-walk.name: Sideways walking
tips: Step to the side, feet together
Toes point forward, hips level
Stay near a counter or wall
bl.side-walk.easier: Smaller steps, one hand on the counter
bl.side-walk.harder: Slightly bigger steps, same slow pace

limitNotes.dizzy: Small steps, one hand on the counter
limitNotes.unsteady: Both hands on the counter, small steps

bl.heel-toe-walk.name: Heel-to-toe walk
tips: Fingertips on the wall beside you
Heel lands right in front of toes
Eyes ahead, one slow step at a time
bl.heel-toe-walk.easier: Leave a small gap between steps
bl.heel-toe-walk.harder: A few more steps, same slow pace

bl.back-walk.name: Walking backwards
bl.back-walk.purpose: For stepping back from a counter
tips: Hands slide along the counter
Toes first, then the heel
Eyes ahead, small slow steps
bl.back-walk.harder: Ten steps, one hand on the counter

bl.walk-turn.name: Walk and turn
tips: Walk along your counter
Turn in tiny steps
A hand within reach the whole time
bl.walk-turn.easier: Both hands on the counter for the turn

bl.heel-toe-walking.name: Heel and toe walking
tips: One hand on the counter
Toes up for the heel steps
Heels up for the toe steps
bl.heel-toe-walking.easier: Raise heels and toes standing still
bl.heel-toe-walking.harder: A few more steps, same slow pace
